summary: Anthropic spent the first five months of 2026 building an infrastructure bench one hire a month, while OpenAI lost three of its five senior operating executives, Google surrendered a Gemini co-architect and then four senior scientists in a single afternoon, and Apple handed its next chapter to an engineer promoted from hardware rather than an outside AI star. Twenty verified moves anchor this roster, ranked by strategic weight: scale of the team that moved, seniority of the role, the rationale a company stated or analysts inferred, compensation signal where disclosed, competitive timing, and control over a scarce resource, whether that resource is compute, research talent, or institutional trust. Infrastructure and continuity dominate the pattern that emerges: Anthropic recruited more procurement, security, and real-estate leads than headline researchers, and the year's single largest departure event, Jeff Dean's exit from Google to found Discovery Loop, took three more senior scientists with it in one afternoon.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: The Startup Idea That Convinced a UW Computer Science Legend to Leave Google After 27 Years
moves.read: Twenty-seven years of institutional memory left Google in a single afternoon, and Google chose to fund the exit rather than fight it.
moves.why: The largest single-company senior-researcher departure verified in 2026, and the clearest sign a hyperscaler will bankroll a rival to keep its former chief scientist close.

moves.title: Founder
moves.sourceTitle: Fidji Simo Steps Down From OpenAI's No. 2 Role
moves.read: OpenAI's second-ranking executive stepped back for health reasons months before an anticipated public offering, leaving the applications business without a named successor.
moves.why: Removed the executive most directly responsible for turning OpenAI's research into consumer revenue, timed awkwardly against IPO preparation.

moves.title: Researcher
moves.sourceTitle: Google Gemini Co-Lead Noam Shazeer Leaves for OpenAI
moves.read: A Transformer co-author Google spent billions reclaiming in 2024 left again in 2026, this time for the lab that never stopped courting him.
moves.why: A repeat departure that a nine-figure retention deal failed to prevent signals compensation alone cannot secure loyalty at the frontier-research tier.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: The Startup Idea That Convinced a UW Computer Science Legend to Leave Google After 27 Years
moves.read: Dean's longtime systems partner left alongside him, pairing decades of infrastructure engineering with the new venture's research ambitions.
moves.why: Paired with Dean, the move signals the departure was a coordinated founding team rather than one executive's exit.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: The Startup Idea That Convinced a UW Computer Science Legend to Leave Google After 27 Years
moves.read: A senior DeepMind research vice president joined the Discovery Loop founding group, pulling frontier-model research leadership out of Google alongside its infrastructure leadership.
moves.why: Extended the Discovery Loop departure beyond systems engineering into core DeepMind research leadership, widening the hole it left.

moves.title: Co-Founder
moves.sourceTitle: The Startup Idea That Convinced a UW Computer Science Legend to Leave Google After 27 Years
moves.read: A founding member of Google Brain joined Dean's new venture, closing a research lineage that traces to Google's earliest deep-learning bet.
moves.why: Rounds out a four-person founding team with a combined multi-decade research pedigree, rare among 2026 startup launches.

moves.title: Chief Executive Officer
moves.sourceTitle: Tim Cook to Become Apple Executive Chairman, John Ternus to Become Apple CEO
moves.read: Apple's board promoted a 25-year hardware veteran to chief executive, effective Sept. 1, over any external AI-focused candidate.
moves.why: Puts an engineer in charge of Apple's next artificial intelligence chapter, a bet on hardware-software integration over recruiting an outside AI star.

moves.title: Executive Chairman
moves.sourceTitle: Tim Cook to Become Apple Executive Chairman, John Ternus to Become Apple CEO
moves.read: Cook moved to the board rather than departing outright, keeping his institutional knowledge available through Apple's leadership transition.
moves.why: Closes a 15-year Apple CEO tenure while preserving continuity, a template other boards weighing AI-era leadership change may study.

moves.title: Head of Pre-training Team
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: An OpenAI co-founder and former Tesla AI director chose the lab built partly by former OpenAI safety researchers to lead pre-training.
moves.why: The single most symbolic name-recruitment win of 2026 among labs still racing toward frontier models.

moves.title: unannounced
moves.sourceTitle: Fidji Simo Steps Down From OpenAI's No. 2 Role
moves.read: OpenAI's chief product officer departed months before Simo, an early signal of the operating turnover that followed.
moves.why: The first of three senior OpenAI operating departures inside a six-month span, preceding the wider exodus narrative.

moves.title: unannounced
moves.sourceTitle: Fidji Simo Steps Down From OpenAI's No. 2 Role
moves.read: OpenAI's chief marketing officer left the same month as Weil to focus on cancer treatment, a departure grounded in personal health.
moves.why: Compounded April's operating leadership loss at OpenAI ahead of Simo's July exit, deepening the pattern CNBC later flagged to investors.

moves.title: Infrastructure Team Lead
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A Microsoft Azure AI platform president crossed to Anthropic's infrastructure team, evidence that cloud incumbents are losing talent to the labs they serve.
moves.why: Signals frontier labs now recruit senior cloud-platform operators, not only researchers, from the hyperscalers underwriting their compute.

moves.title: Computing Infrastructure Lead
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A founding xAI infrastructure member moved directly to a rival lab's compute team, a lateral move rare among frontier-lab founding staff.
moves.why: Shows frontier labs recruiting each other's infrastructure benches as readily as their research staffs.

moves.title: Global Real Estate & Construction Lead
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A logistics-industry real estate executive joined Anthropic to build physical footprint, not code.
moves.why: Confirms Anthropic's 2026 hiring extends into physical construction capacity, ahead of any public data center announcement.

moves.title: Head of Transformation Management Office
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A Google finance transformation leader joined to manage Anthropic's internal operational scaling.
moves.why: An operations-management hire that points to Anthropic formalizing internal processes as headcount grows quickly.

moves.title: Director of Compute Infrastructure Procurement
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A finance executive with prior Apple experience now runs Anthropic's compute procurement, tying financial discipline to hardware buying.
moves.why: One of the earliest 2026 signals that Anthropic was staffing for large-scale compute purchasing months before its infrastructure hiring wave peaked.

moves.title: Infrastructure Development Lead
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A data center developer's chief development officer joined Anthropic to lead infrastructure buildout directly.
moves.why: A data-center industry veteran joining a model lab underscores how physical build-out has become core AI-lab hiring, not an outsourced function.

moves.title: Head of Security
moves.fromTitle: Vice President, Global Strategic Security Programs
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A Google global security VP took over Anthropic's security function early in the year, ahead of the heaviest infrastructure hiring months.
moves.why: Security leadership arriving before the infrastructure buildout peaked suggests Anthropic sequenced protection ahead of physical expansion.

moves.title: Head of International Go-to-Market
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: A Stripe leadership-enablement executive joined to run Anthropic's push into international markets.
moves.why: One of the year's first named Anthropic hires, marking January as the opening month of its 2026 hiring wave.

moves.title: India Office Lead
moves.sourceTitle: Anthropic's Top 10 Hires of 2026 as It Lures Talent From OpenAI, Google, xAI and Microsoft
moves.read: Microsoft India's managing director left to open Anthropic's Bengaluru office, corroborated separately by Indian business press.
moves.why: Anthropic's earliest confirmed 2026 move and the first sign international office expansion, not only U.S. research hiring, would define its year.
